title: Titanium Centering Ring (KF/ISO)
function: KF/ISO centering ring for vacuum seals
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is specified for Titanium Centering Ring (KF/ISO) because its non-magnetic permeability (µ <1.0001) eliminates interference with electron beam trajectories in vacuum processing chambers. The low sputter yield of Ti (0.3 atoms/ion at 500eV Ar+) compared to Al (1.2) reduces cross-contamination in thin-film deposition tools. Matched thermal expansion (8.6 µm/m°C) with ceramic end-effectors prevents particle generation during thermal cycling — critical for KF/ISO centering ring for vacuum seals. This rationale is driven by kf/iso centering ring for vacuum seals and specific design requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for chamber seal geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse at 200W fiber laser
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for kfiso centering ring application
commonFailures: Metal particle shedding >1e10 at/cm2 - eliminated by UHP VAR+ESR double-melt + electropolished ID — critical for kfiso centering ring performance

faq.q: What is the magnetic permeability of Titanium Centering Ring (KF/ISO)?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V has a magnetic permeability µ < 1.0001 (effectively non-magnetic), essential for kfiso centering ring in electron beam lithography, ion implantation, and SEM/EDX tool chambers where magnetic materials would deflect charged particle beams. Permeability is verified per ASTM A342 for each production batch.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Centering Ring (KF/ISO) orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Centering Ring (KF/ISO) is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Centering Ring (KF/ISO)?
faq.a: Each Titanium Centering Ring (KF/ISO) shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for kfiso centering ring.
